_twist: caitlin-christinee grid was nearly empty (section-max-width: 9999px, no columns defined). Twist: establish a complete editorial 12-column grid with named template areas — full-bleed, content (cols 2-11), narrow (cols 4-9), and editorial split (cols 1-6 / 7-12). Adds a generous gutter that scales with viewport, and explicit breakpoints for the 4 standard widths.

full-bleed.description: Full-width grid — bleeds to viewport edges. Used for hero sections, dividers, and background layers.

editorial-12.description: 12-column editorial base grid. Content occupies columns 2-11, narrow content columns 4-9.

content-span.description: Standard content area — columns 2 through 11. Leaves 1 column breathing room on each edge.

narrow-span.description: Narrow reading column — columns 4 through 9. Used for long-form text, pull quotes, and captions.

editorial-split.description: Equal 50/50 split. Left panel carries the editorial caption/label, right panel the primary content or image.

bento-asymmetric.description: TWIST: Asymmetric bento — large cell (2fr) spans grid-row 1/3, two smaller cells in the right column stack vertically.

three-column.description: Three equal columns. Used for instrument catalog tiles and feature triptych sections.

footer.description: Footer grid — wide brand column plus three link-list columns.

visual.description: Viewport-filling hero with oversized Cormorant Garamond heading — letterforms at clamp(8rem, 18vw, 14rem) function as background texture at opacity 0.04.
Asymmetric bento: left large cell (2fr, grid-row 1/3) shows a primary instrument detail. Right column stacks two smaller tiles — one a stat/number cell, one a caption block.
Three equal instrument catalog tiles with warm linen surface backgrounds and thin greige borders.
Long-form editorial text confined to columns 4-9 for comfortable measure (~65 characters per line).
